result: In `packet_fifo_core`, replace the integer `occupancy` counter with a one-hot state vector of `DEPTH+1` bits, where bit `i` means occupancy is `i`; update it for push-only and pop-only, and hold it for simultaneous push/pop or neither. Preserve the top interface, `// @latency 1`, reset behavior, FIFO ordering, stalls, and all supported parameter configurations.
